input: Source a second-hand road bike for commuting

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Budget is the single biggest filter when shopping second-hand — it determines which bikes, platforms, and sellers are even worth considering.
The commute distance and terrain (flat city streets vs. hilly routes) directly dictate the gearing, frame geometry, and tyre width needed.
Whether the user is buying locally (in-person inspection) or open to shipping changes which platforms to use and what checks are necessary.
Knowing where they plan to look (Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, local bike shops, specialist sites) shapes what the action plan should prioritise.
The rider's experience level affects how much mechanical inspection guidance they need and whether a bike fitting or professional check is required.
Specific priorities — e.g. lightweight, mudguard mounts, rack mounts, disc vs. rim brakes — narrow the search criteria significantly.
Understanding what 'done' looks like (bike purchased and rideable immediately vs. willing to do minor repairs) determines how selective to be and what condition to accept.

gold.taskTitle: Source a second-hand road bike for commuting
gold.taskDescription: Find and purchase a used road bike suitable for daily commuting.
